manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Builds a queryable git-tracked warehouse from any repo's data by running a shaper script, committing on change, and emitting the Datasette command.
manifest.name: @kody-w/git_warehouse_agent

action.description: shape = run the shaper to (re)build the warehouse; scrape = shape then git-commit it (history becomes the time-series); serve = return the datasette command; history = summarize warehouse changes over commits. Default scrape.

message.description: For scrape: the git commit message. Defaults to a timestamped git-scraper-style message.

push.description: For scrape: also `git push` after committing (publishes the warehouse). Default false.

repo.description: Absolute path to the git repository whose data to warehouse. Required for all actions.

shaper.description: Path to the shaper .py to run (the script that reads the repo's raw data and emits the warehouse files). Relative to repo or absolute. Defaults to 'warehouse/build.py'.

warehouse.description: Warehouse output directory within the repo (where the shaper writes events.jsonl / frames.jsonl / metadata.json / stats.json). Default 'warehouse'.
